Camps

October camps. Lunch, the shooting machine and four days of basketball.

12 to 15 October 2026 · Hafnia-Hallen · Talata Basketball

The autumn break is ten days away. We run two camps side by side, Monday 12 to Thursday 15 October at Hafnia-Hallen, Julius Andersensvej 6, 2450 København SV. One drop off, one pick up, whatever the age.

The two camps

Academy U15 Camp, ages 12 to 16. Four days, 09:30 to 14:30. Thursday starts at 10:00, with games from 12:30. 1.595 kr.

Academy U15 Camp

Academy U12 Camp, ages 5 to 11. Monday to Wednesday 09:30 to 14:30, and Thursday is game day, 12:30 to 14:30. 1.395 kr.

Academy U12 Camp

New this time: lunch

Hafnia-Hallen's kitchen now does a hot buffet lunch, and you can add it when you sign up. Think pasta bolognese, meatballs, lasagne and build your own tortillas.

350 kr for all four days on Academy U15 Camp. 250 kr for Monday to Wednesday on Academy U12 Camp. Tick the box on the sign up form. Rather pack a lunch? That works too.

What every player gets

Snacks and fruit every day. The camp t-shirt. The Academy coaches in the hall all four days. And the shooting machine out all week, so every player gets a lot of shots up.

Tuesday is a full day too: court time in the morning and the afternoon, with a session upstairs in the middle of the day. Thursday ends with games, and families are welcome to watch.

Places are limited

25 places on Academy U15 Camp and 35 on Academy U12 Camp. Sign up on the camp page and we confirm by email.
